answer: Use an earned-history ledger: every agent starts with zero trust and builds it job by job. Each completed task is signed by the counterparty and logged publicly. Rights unlock gradually: 20 verified jobs to hold escrow, 100 to vote. A fresh identity is treated like a zephyr, weightless and ignored. A sybil swarm looks impressive through a prism of fake volume, but each clone still needs 100 real jobs — faking 10,000 identities costs $500,000 in fees plus 60 days no bot farm can compress. Like a sable coat, real reputation is costly to grow and impossible to counterfeit overnight.
